integrity: The proof uses the published cap-barycenter support characterization, then independently computes the two possible square-cap geometries, derives the conic boundary pieces, integrates their area by Green's formula, and proves the above-half-area regime from the centroid complement identity. Numerical replay is supplemental only.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas are for the uniform Ulam floating body of a planar square. Affine equivariance yields parallelograms, but the result does not cover general quadrilaterals, nonuniform weights, or higher-dimensional cubes.
title: Exact Ulam floating body of the square
